## Step 2: Add them up

## Step 3: One figure left out
On 29 May you mentioned about 5 gaming sessions in the past month, each lasting 2–3 hours (roughly 10–15 hours). I didn't add these because they probably overlap with the games above, such as the Overwatch session. If they were separate playtime, your total would be about 125–130 hours.
